notes: The catalog text does not contain a section for 'Advanced Manufacturing Level I'. It prints only 'Certificate of Achievement in Advanced Manufacturing' (Program Code 37939.00CA), which requires 16 MFG courses totaling 62.00 units. That is well above the 16-30 unit range of the named award.

Nothing was recorded from that section, because it belongs to a different, larger award. The four closed-list courses (MFG 10 8, MFG 12 3, MFG 14 3, MFG 16 3; 17 units) match exactly 'Term 1' (17.00 units) of the 62-unit certificate's map.
A Level I certificate may have been merged into the full certificate in this catalog year. A reviewer should check whether a separate Level I page exists.

The 62-unit certificate prints a prerequisite of ITEC 55 and seven distinct program learning outcomes; the first is repeated at the end of the list. The outcomes were not recorded for Level I because they are printed for the 62-unit certificate.
The 62-unit certificate's other courses are MFG 20, 22, 24, 26, 30, 32, 34, 36, 40, 42, 44 and 46. All are absent from the closed list.
